text: The India–EU Free Trade Agreement was declared concluded at which India–EU Summit in January 2026?
explanation:

explanation:

explanation:

  • National Youth Day is on 12 January.

text: Which day is observed on 25 January along with National Voters' Day?
explanation:
• National Tourism Day is on 25 January, the same day as National Voters' Day.
  • National Girl Child Day is on 24 January (since 2008).
  • National Startup Day is on 16 January.
  • World Tourism Day is on 27 September.

text: The UN has declared 2026 as the International Year of:
explanation:
• The UN declared 2026 the International Year of Rangelands and Pastoralists.
  • 2023 was the International Year of Millets, proposed by India.
  • 2024 was the International Year of Camelids.
  • 2026 is also the ASEAN–India Year of Maritime Cooperation.
